sentence: A GPT earns the label because it makes "new and complementary production methods" available, which raise output only over time
passage: [Czarnitzki et al. (2023), p. 188] "The main feature of general-purpose technology is to enable new and complementary production methods that may increase productivity over time (Bresnahan and Trajtenberg 1995; Bresnahan et al., 2002; Brynjolfsson and Hitt 2003; Cardona et al., 2013)."

gemini.note: The passage states that new methods "may increase productivity," whereas the sentence presents this as a certainty and adds the restrictive word "only."
